moat_against: Payments processing commoditizing; rivals discount hardware/software to buy share
SMB restaurant customer base has high failure/churn rates
No consumer-side network effect — diners don't choose restaurants by POS vendor
Pricing resentment over processing fees and add-on stacking drives price-shopping
moat_for: Restaurant-specific depth no horizontal rival matches (KDS, tables, tips, ordering in one stack)
Switching costs — POS + payments + payroll/loyalty are mission-critical and painful to rip out
Scale and data across ~180,000 locations feeding product/AI features and underwriting
Expanding wallet per location — fintech, payroll, marketing, new verticals
moat_justification: US restaurant-POS leader with real switching costs (POS + payments + back-office modules run daily operations) and expanding wallet per location across ~180,000 sites, but the SMB restaurant customer base is fragile, payments take-rates are contestable, and Square/Clover/Lightspeed/Shift4 discount aggressively — a moderate-strong moat that must be re-defended location by location.
name: Toast, Inc.
one_liner: High-quality restaurant platform, moat 6/10, growing ~23% with a real profit inflection — but at $32.22 even the super-bull case returns only 13.8%; weighted IRR 9.0%, IV@15 $14.46, clears 15% only near ~$14.46.
